# 1 Enoch Chapter 9 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all verses in 1 Enoch Chapter 9 where the three translators (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA) significantly diverged in their renderings, along with SOPHIA's resolution and reasoning.

---

## 9:2 — 'desolated earth cries out' vs. 'ravaged earth screams' — the personification of earth

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "The-earth made-without-inhabitant cries the-voice of-their-crying" | Hyper-literal: preserves Ge'ez cognate accusative construction |
| LOGOS | "The desolated earth cries out" | Preserves personification; 'desolated' captures the emptied state |
| PNEUMA | "The ravaged earth screams" | 'Screams' conveys the intensity; 'ravaged' implies violence done to the earth |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted 'desolated earth cries out' (LOGOS). The Ge'ez describes an earth emptied of proper inhabitants — 'desolated' captures this better than 'ravaged' (which implies active violence against the earth itself). 'Cries out' preserves the legal-petition register; 'screams' (PNEUMA) shifts to raw emotion.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS. Register-significant — legal petition, not raw anguish.

---

## 9:4 — divine epithets — 'Lord of the ages' vs. 'Lord of eternity'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Lord of-the-ages" | Literal rendering of Ge'ez 'egzi'a 'alamat — plural 'ages/worlds' |
| LOGOS | "Lord of the ages" | Same as EMET; preserves the plural |
| PNEUMA | "Lord of eternity" | Singular abstract noun; more natural in English prayer/worship language |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted 'Lord of the ages' (EMET/LOGOS). The Ge'ez plural 'alamat (ages/worlds) is theologically richer than the singular abstract 'eternity' — it implies sovereignty over multiple eons or cosmic periods, which is central to Enochic eschatology.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS. Theologically significant — Enochic periodization of history.

---
